title: Brand Meme & Misc Asset Inventory
body:
Internal working inventory of visual and miscellaneous assets collected by GTM. NOT approved for external publication unless explicitly marked "approved". This doc is intentionally messy — a grab-bag of meme ideas, placeholder hero images, spin-up one-pagers, and legacy logos. Use as a quick reference when AEs or content need something fast for demos, social, or slide decks.

Sections:
- Overview: quick status, intended audience, license notes.
- Inventory: (filename | short desc | suggested usage | owner | status)
  - redwood-meme-pack-2025-v1.png | assortment of reaction panels + captions | social, internal email headers | owner: Liam O'Connor | status: draft (internal only)
  - hero-placeholder-canyon.jpg | stock photo, warm tone, overlay mock "Powered by Redwood" | suggested for demo slides / hero banners | owner: Priya Desai | status: needs crop
  - onepager-fast-start-template.pdf | single-page blurb + bullets for AE leave-behind | owner: Maya Chen | status: WIP (see linked_artifacts)
  - old-logo-neon.svg | legacy experimental logo from hackathon | owner: Hackathons repo | status: archival (do not use externally)

Usage notes:
- Quick checklist before publishing: verify license, export high-res approved file, add alt text, assign asset id in CMS, create a canonical version in go-to-market/brand-assets.
- Meme guidance: keep internal tone; avoid PII or targeting competitors; legal review required for paid/boosted campaigns.

To-dos:
- Priya: crop and retone hero-placeholder-canyon.jpg (due 2025-03-10).
- Maya: draft "quick-ask" Slack template for ad-hoc asset requests (due 2025-03-05).
- Liam: produce 5 caption variants for meme pack and upload to assets folder by EOD Fri.

Slack snippets & comments (copied for context):
- Liam: "I threw together some panels in Figma; all internal LOLs, but could be useful for AE warm intros :shrug:"
- Priya: "Crop suggestions: 16:9 for slides, 4:3 for case studies. Will add a few exports."

Audit notes:
- Images pulled from Unsplash and internal hackathon mock-ups. CREDIT to original photographers must be recorded; confirm license before external use. Some illustrations are derived from generative mock-ups — flag for legal review if used in marketing.

Links & references:
- Confluence quick link: confluence/product-launch-2025 (internal)
- Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder

Notes:
- This doc is a scratchpad and intentionally informal. If an asset is promoted to canonical status, move it to go-to-market/brand-assets, update its filename to include a version tag, and change status to "final".

End of inventory.
